verdict.rationale: The only first-party bulk capability is in the Local Search API: its `ids` parameter accepts up to 20 location IDs in one request, for both POI details and AI-generated descriptions. That is a narrow batch fetch, not general bulk operations; pagination and multi-search grounding in Answers are single-request behaviors, not user-driven bulk operations. Missing for 10: batch or bulk query submission for web, news, image or video search, documented limits and semantics for bulk jobs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk usage.
